rowan.name: Rowan Bell
rowan.ordinary: You must be the lookout technician. Mara called ahead. The marked relay case is yours. The counted supplies set out here are on the crew account; take what you need and leave the rest.
rowan.worried: Still no delivery. I keep checking the same empty road. Your reserved equipment is here, though.
rowan.ill: My brother came up from the city on Sunday. I stayed with him before you arrived. I thought it was the same fever everyone was talking about. Now I'm shaking too. Sam said to stop serving and keep away from people. Your cases are still marked.

topics.label: The lookout equipment
topics.ordinary: The transfer relay is in the marked case. Fit it with your insulated kit and verify the cabinet afterwards. There's a matched winter controller here too; Mara's issue record lists the connectors and tested lead it needs.
topics.worried: Both reserved cases are still here. I haven't issued them to anybody else. The controller improves your own array; it won't bring the town supply back.
topics.ill: Marked case. The ledger has the rest. Please keep your distance.

topics.label: The supply delivery
topics.ordinary: The truck is expected tomorrow afternoon. Leave room for your return load. Nobody enjoys carrying water uphill twice.
topics.worried: The truck is due this afternoon. There's nothing new here yet. Lin's keeping the junction space clear.
topics.ill: It never came. The depot stopped answering. Don't wait for a fresh delivery.

topics.label: People in town
topics.ordinary: Sam keeps the clinic reserves counted. Lin is checking the entrance outside. We're a small place; somebody usually knows whose lights have gone out.
topics.worried: My brother is resting at home. He came up from the city on Sunday with this fever. The clinic has had more callers too. I don't know what's happening beyond this road.
topics.ill: Sam called to say people were hurt at the clinic. I can't get an answer at home now. Please don't go looking for my brother on my account.

lin.name: Lin Hu
lin.ordinary: I'm checking the delivery space and the store entrance. Your marked service case is inside with Rowan.

topics.label: The delivery
topics.ordinary: Tomorrow afternoon, if the truck gets through. These orders aren't new stock yet; Rowan has already set your relay aside.

sam.name: Sam Roy
sam.ordinary: Just checking the entrance before the next shift. The reserve dressings are inside. Take what you need and leave the rest for the next person.

topics.label: The clinic reserves
topics.ordinary: The dressings and antiseptic are separate reserves. A bandage stops bleeding; it won't replace lost blood. Stay warm, fed and hydrated afterwards.
